svg.text: Dotted arrow: Kali → Windows (RDP 3389, SSH 22), observed in Sysmon on Windows.
Dashed arrows: SSH 22 (Mac → VMs), observed in Splunk telemetry. Attk101 attack source: Mac → Kali.
Telemetry stays inside the lab network and is forwarded only to the Splunk Manager.
The live console and management API are bound to loopback for local analyst use.
